description:
Static review of line-breaking and typography settings where CJK or Thai text appears. Pass `source` as HTML with styles, or CSS plus sample text. Detects Han, kana, Hangul and Thai in the content, then flags word-break: break-all and keep-all used on the wrong script, missing lang (which selects glyph variants and break rules),
inside CJK paragraphs, spaces between CJK characters, widths set in ch, line-height under 1.5, letter-spacing, italics, nowrap, and lines starting with closing punctuation. Mentions line-break strict and loose and phrase-aware breaking where relevant. Reads the pasted source only; nothing is rendered or run, stored or logged. Wrapping happens in the browser, so check in a real one with a native reader.

source.description: HTML with styles, or CSS plus sample text.

name: check_cjk_line_breaking
title: CJK line breaking check
